shr_landlord.text: Ow bist? That's Shropshire for 'how are you'. You say 'Ah, middlin'', and then I pour you something.
We're called The Coracle after the little round boats. There's one on the wall. It's not for hire after closing, whatever my brother-in-law says.

shr_quizmaster.text: Quiz night at The Coracle! Five questions. Shropshire questions get extra marks for pronunciation.
Rules: no phones, no shouting out, and no starting the Shrews or Shrows argument. That's a separate event on Saturdays.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Suit yourself. The crisps are cheese and onion either way.
